import os, subprocess
from pathlib import Path

wt=Path("/Users/steventran/.do_again/lifecycle-ci-20261007")
expected="65f9a3e792c3cf3fa951df21fe9114a180d85d40"

def run(args,check=True,env=None):
    return subprocess.run(args,cwd=wt,text=True,capture_output=True,check=check,env=env)

if run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip()!=expected:
    raise SystemExit("unexpected head")
if run(["git","branch","--show-current"]).stdout.strip()!="feat/ci-wait-lifecycle-20261007":
    raise SystemExit("unexpected branch")
if run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout.strip():
    raise SystemExit("worktree not clean")

env=os.environ.copy()
env["PYTHONPATH"]=str(wt/"src")
full=run(["python3","-m","unittest","discover","-s","tests","-v"],check=False,env=env)
print("=== full stdout ===")
print(full.stdout)
print("=== full stderr ===")
print(full.stderr)
print("full_rc="+str(full.returncode))
if full.returncode:
    raise SystemExit(full.returncode)

print("head_after="+run(["git","rev-parse","HEAD"]).stdout.strip())
print("status_after="+repr(run(["git","status","--porcelain=v1"]).stdout))
